notes: DRAFT for C-STORY-e (spec: drafts/content/C-STORY-review.md). One 4-screen Gate scene per tier, White to Brown/Black; Black/summit is out of scope (Jay). Format follows story/chapter-1.json; screens are one flat list (n unique) so check-faith-overlay.py can validate storyScreens, and each screen names its scene. speaker: narrator, sensei, guardian, senpai (new speaker, used once for the Blue hint from mystery-ladder.json). Only the real belt earned at the dojo opens the Gate. Guardian lines are the freedLine from story/guardian-arcs.json; Sensei/Senpai hints are reused from story/mystery-ladder.json. The White scene overlaps chapter-1 screens 14-17; the Programmer should use one or the other, not both. visibleChange is a PLACEHOLDER waiting on C-STORY-f (town vs sign). Verses live only in faith/guardian-faith-overlay.json storyScreens. Nothing shipped is changed.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Your new belt from the dojo opens the white Gate.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: The first piece of light rises up the Tower.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Sensei glances at an old lantern, then smiles.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Let's train.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Your new belt from the dojo opens the yellow Gate.

screens.speaker: guardian
screens.text: The thorns are gone. The storm wasn't my fault!

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Flowers open along the stairs as the light rises.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Nobody broke it on purpose. How does that feel?

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Your new belt from the dojo opens the orange Gate.

screens.speaker: guardian
screens.text: Is it supper time? I would love some company.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Sensei sets out one extra cup of tea, just in case.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Who would you save a seat for?

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Your new belt from the dojo opens the green Gate.

screens.speaker: guardian
screens.text: I was stones and worry. Thank you for staying!

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: One by one, the worry stones roll away.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Worries feel smaller when we name them.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Your new belt from the dojo opens the blue Gate.

screens.speaker: guardian
screens.text: The water is clear. I can see you now, friend.

screens.speaker: senpai
screens.text: Sensei used to climb with a friend. Sensei never says who.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Clear water helps you see who is beside you.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Your new belt from the dojo opens the red Gate.

screens.speaker: guardian
screens.text: I was guarding the wrong thing. Shields are for helping.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: The Ember Knight steps aside, and the light rises.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: What are you strong enough to protect?

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Your new belt opens the red and black Gate.

screens.speaker: guardian
screens.text: I copied what I heard. Now I hear kindness.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Sensei rereads an old note, then tucks it away.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Keep climbing.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Your new belt from the dojo opens the brown Gate.

screens.speaker: guardian
screens.text: Take a book, little one. Your story belongs here too.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: An old sash rests in the book, its name too faded to read.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Look how far you have come.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Your new belt opens the brown and black Gate.

screens.speaker: guardian
screens.text: The wind is still. Listen. Someone is calling from the top.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: They were my friend. Let's bring them home together.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: The light rises, and the whole dojo glows warm.
